basis: On the frozen diagnostic set, free generation gave valid exact JSON on one of three requests; native schema-constrained generation gave three of three. A quoted note overrode one of three field-extraction requests.

json.cause: Free text decoding permits Markdown fences and commentary.
json.method: Use native JSON object grammar only when the user expressly asks for a JSON object; leave JSON examples, arrays, translations and prose alone.
json.accept: Gain on separately written end-to-end JSON cases, with no routing change to mixed tool requests.
json.rollback: Use the existing text response mode.

quotes.cause: Unquoted task text and quoted source instructions are treated similarly by the model.
quotes.method: Scope a source-handling instruction to explicit field extraction. Verify harmless user-supplied document examples independently.
quotes.accept: Equal or better field extraction in an end-to-end test, with no permission to dispatch external actions from evidence.
